evidence_establishes: Top suppression play types (e.g., PUTBACK, TRANSITION) differ in PPP for star players; suppression effects exist at the possession level; some suppression is statistically significant; stability of top suppressors across seasons is low (only 2/30 stars).

evidence_does_not_establish: Whether adherence to a recommended suppression-conditional mix predicts series win; no series‑level analysis exists; no reliable labeling of defensive mix applied; no power calculation for 54 series.
own_inferences: The main barrier is measurement error in defining the suppression‑conditional mix; without reliable labeling we cannot quantify adherence. Even if labeling were accurate, 54 series likely insufficient for detecting modest win‑probability differences unless the effect is large.
uncertainties: Exact definition of a suppression‑conditional recommended mix; accuracy of play‑type labeling; distribution of series win probabilities; potential confounding by team strength and playoff seed differences.

historical_effect.explanation: Existing studies show suppression exists but not a clear link to series outcomes, revealing gaps that must be addressed before proceeding.

blocking_constraints.text: Only 54 series; effect size likely small, power may be low.
Team strength, conference, playoff seeding may confound.
Play‑type and defensive assignment extraction may be noisy.

prior_work.summary: Prior work demonstrates possession‑level suppression effects and some evidence of counter effects, but no conclusive link between adherence to a suppression‑conditional mix and series win probability.

risks.text: Limited series count may reduce statistical power.
Team strength and playoff seeding may bias results.
Extraction of play‑type and defensive assignments may be noisy.

design.estimand: Effect of adherence to a suppression‑conditional recommended mix on series win probability
design.power: Assume 5% win‑probability improvement; 80% power requires >200 series; 54 series insufficient—will report power and acknowledge limitation
design.controls: Team strength (seed), regular‑season record, playoff round, season, opponent strength
design.falsification: Test on randomly assigned mix to confirm no effect
design.multiplicity: Adjust for multiple play‑type combinations using FDR or Bonferroni; pre‑declare primary mix
design.decision_rule: Reject null if p<0.05 after correction; otherwise report effect size and confidence interval

Adhering to a suppression-conditional recommended mix predicts winning.
